audit.method: Compared all directory member portrait IDs and every grouped profile name with current/historical identity records, checking name components, suffixes, state and service era; manually reviewed name variations and all mismatches. Filer transaction dates distinguish father/son collisions. Portrait verification is HTTP HEAD 200 with image content type, not a visual rendering check.
audit.notes: Alan Armstrong is already sourced separately from the official Senate website. A. Mitchell remains ambiguous and must keep a neutral placeholder. All suggested portrait URLs below returned HTTP 200 with image/jpeg or image/webp.

corrections.name: April McClain Delaney
corrections.reason: D000620 is John K. Delaney, whose service ended in 2019. M001232 is April McClain Delaney, serving MD-06 from 2025.

corrections.name: Mike Collins
corrections.reason: C000640 is father Michael Allen 'Mac' Collins, whose service ended 2005. C001129 is Mike Allen Collins Jr. The unsuffixed source profile's trades run 2023-10-09 through 2024-12-03, identifying the son. Upstream office GA-08 is also incorrect; use GA-10.

corrections.name: Richard McCormick
corrections.reason: M000371 is Richard Cunningham McCormick, whose congressional service ended 1897. M001218 is Rich Dean McCormick, GA-06 in 2023-2025 and GA-07 from 2025.

corrections.name: Cathy McMorris Rodgers
corrections.reason: R000373 is Robert Lewis Rodgers of Pennsylvania, whose service ended 1947. M001159 is Cathy Anne McMorris Rodgers of WA-05. Upstream PA state is also incorrect.

corrections.name: Lizzie Fletcher
corrections.reason: F000441 is Ernest Lee Fletcher of KY-06, whose service ended 2003. House History identifies Elizabeth Pannill Fletcher as F000468, Democrat from Texas serving since 2019; source transaction is dated 2026-04-08. Upstream party R and office KY-06 are also incorrect.

corrections.name: John D. Dingell
corrections.reason: D000354 is his father John David Dingell. D000355 is John D. Dingell whose service ended 2015; source transaction date 2014-09-18 identifies the son. Final district was MI-12 (2013-2015); MI-15 was valid in earlier years.
